title: Secret Agent Cipher
description: An intelligence agency encodes numerical messages where each letter from A to Z is mapped to a digit or a pair of digits: 'A' to 'I' correspond to '1' through '9', and 'J' to 'Z' correspond to '10' through '26'. Given a string of digits, determine the total number of ways it can be decoded back into alphabetical text.
constraints: s consists of digits only and may contain leading zeros.
input_format: A string s representing the numeric message.
output_format: An integer representing the total number of valid decodings.

examples.explanation: "06" cannot be mapped to any letter because '6' with a leading zero is invalid in this cipher.
